**Core.** Work through it, with the exercises.

## Planned topics

- Cluster anatomy: login vs compute nodes; partitions, accounts, QOS, and each site's defaults and time limits (`sinfo`, `scontrol show partition`)
- Storage tiers: home, project, scratch, and node-local temporary space (`$TMPDIR`); quotas (site quota command) and purges
- File-count (inode) quotas: millions of small files (a Nextflow `work/` directory, environments in `$HOME`) can fill an account that has bytes to spare
- Environment modules (`module load`, Lmod) beside the book's pixi environment
- Interactive jobs (`srun --pty`, `salloc`); connecting to a node you hold (`ProxyJump`, completing @sec-working-remotely) and giving it back
- A running process vs a submitted job
- `sbatch` scripts that wrap @sec-shell-scripts's scripts; resource requests (CPUs, memory, time; passing the CPU count to the tool)
- Why jobs wait or fail: pending reasons, out of memory, time limit, missing file
- Estimating memory, time, and disk for a job; measuring a real one (`sacct`, `seff` where the site has it)
- Monitoring and cancelling (`squeue`, `scancel`)
- Job arrays
- Chains of jobs (dependencies) (overview)
- GPU partitions (overview, brief)
- Etiquette: no heavy work on login nodes
